title: GEMM: Fix kernel mapping for some odd tensor shapes

argv:
def pick(t,k,n,b,multi,new):
 a=n%256==0; w=n%512==0; g=a or not new
 if t=='amp':
  if g and b<=4:return 2 if n<=2048 or k<=2048 else 3
  if g and n<4096:return 3 if k>8192 else 2
  if w and n*k>4096**2 and b<=6:return 4
  return 3 if a else 2
 if t=='ada':
  if g and b<=3:return 2 if (k<=2048 and not multi) or (n<4096 and k<=12288) else 3
  if n<=16384:return 2
  if w and n>=32768:return 4
  return 3 if a else 2
 if b in (2,4) and not multi and k<=2048:return 1
 if b>=7:
  if g and n<=8192:return 3 if k>32768 else 2
  return 4 if w and n>32768 else 2
 if g and n<=4096:return 3 if (k>8192 and b>=3 if new else int(bool(k) and b>=3)>8192) else 2
 if w and n>16384:return 4
 return 3 if a else 2
kt=[0,16,32,32,16]; nt=[0,128,128,256,512]
for t,k,n,b in [('amp',4096,2176,4),('amp',16384,2176,6),('ada',16384,2176,3),('hop',32896,2176,7),('hop',16384,4096,3),('hop',8192,4096,3),('hop',16384,4096,1),('hop',16384,2176,3),('hop',2048,2176,2)]:
 s=[pick(t,k,n,b,False,x) for x in (False,True)];print(t,k,n,b,s,[n%nt[i] for i in s],[n//nt[i]*nt[i] for i in s])

for v in False,True:
